candidate.title: Uncaught prisma/calendar lookup error aborts createAllCalendarEvents loop, failing entire booking and orphaning already-created events
reports: packages/core/eventmanager.ts:344 — the sequential per-host loop has no per-destination try/catch, so a prisma/getcalendar failure for one host aborts the remaining hosts and loses already-created events (no references saved, so they are orphaned).

packages/core/eventmanager.ts:336-408 — createallcalendarevents has no try/catch anywhere in the method, so a thrown error from prisma.credential.findunique at line 344 (db timeout/connection error) propagates uncaught out of create() (called at eventmanager.ts:142 with no surrounding try/catch either), turning a transient db blip on one destination calendar into a hard failure of the entire booking-creation call for every destination, not just the one whose lookup failed.
